The current plan is still blocked by missing conditional exports. Preserve all six requirements, every real operation, product navigation, original completeness checks, data extraction, workbook write and cleanup. This is the last allowed planning attempt; do not require new discovery or remove work.

Correct only the demonstrated scope composition. The tasks home_complete_guard, after_cookie_complete_guard, extract_product_if_complete, process_complete_search_snapshot, search_amazon_if_possible and visit_products_if_available have meaningful bodies but empty alternatives with required outputs missing. They are stop-on-failure gates, not business choices producing two different values. Reuse existing kind sequence for these scopes, with the current condition combined with their existing requires as a boolean requires. Keep their identities, complete bodies, declared body exports and dependency order intact; remove only their now-inapplicable condition/otherwise fields. Failure of the guard must stop before downstream write, with existing unconditional cleanup; do not invent alternative values or pretend failure is success. sequence keeps a real scope and exports, so existing consumer references can remain through the enclosing task identity. Actual cookie consent remains conditional with matching exports on both alternatives.

Revalidate the whole plan. The TASK_FIELD_TYPE failures depend on the currently invalid conditional interfaces: preserve authoritative object output shapes through these scopes, never cast opaque data, guess fields, strip checks or replace data references by constants. Preserve complete observation acquisition, correctly named each inputs, deterministic completeness checks, compact source-grounded extraction, meaningful global interpretation only on compact observed facts, and all approved bounds. Return the complete corrected plan with unchanged accepted requirements.
